judgments.rewrite_hint: Quote: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” Narrow “with users” to the people or businesses being called; the Ledger supports staff completing exchanges with the other party on some Muse-initiated calls, not calls with Muse users. Fact ID: MUSE-HC-006.

Quote: “So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.” Remove the unsupported assertion about what the people believed; state only that the test lacked proper disclosure and that human contract staff handled some calls. Fact ID: MUSE-HC-012.
